wikipediaSummary.title: Pretenders (album)
wikipediaSummary.extract: Pretenders is the debut studio album by British-American band the Pretenders, released in December 1979 in the United Kingdom and January 1980 in the United States. A combination of rock and roll, punk and new wave music, it was an immediate success. The album features the singles "Stop Your Sobbing", "Kid" and "Brass in Pocket". The track "Private Life" would be covered later that same year by Jamaican singer Grace Jones for her fourth studio album Warm Leatherette and was released as a single that June, reaching number 17 on the UK singles chart.
